map.物业费分摊计算 使用指南: Property fee allocation calculation - user guide
map.录入小区物业总费用与各户面积或户数，工具按比例（可切换按面积或按户）分摊到每户并: Enter the estate's total property fee and each unit's area or count; the tool allocates per unit by ratio (switchable by area or by household) and supports importing custom owner details, generating a per-unit payable list to simplify the owners' committee and property fee accounting.
map.按面积或户数比例分摊物业总费用，支持自定义户主明细: Allocate total property fee by area or household ratio, supporting custom owner details
map.物业按建筑面积把公共能耗与维修费分摊到各户: Property allocates public energy and maintenance fees to households by floor area
map.商住混合楼区分住宅与商业费率分别分摊: Mixed-use building: split residential and commercial rates and allocate separately
map.某户质疑分摊额时，按面积明细逐户解释: When a household disputes its share, explain per household by area detail
map.：总公摊费用 3 万元、可收费总面积 10000 ㎡ → 单价 3 元/㎡；甲户: : total common fee 30k yuan, billable total area 10000 m^2 -> unit price 3 yuan/m^2; household A 100 m^2 pays 300 yuan, B 150 m^2 pays 450 yuan.
map.：住宅 2.5 元/㎡、商业 5 元/㎡；住宅 8000 ㎡、商业 2000 ㎡: : residential 2.5 yuan/m^2, commercial 5 yuan/m^2; residential 8000 m^2, commercial 2000 m^2 -> residential 20k + commercial 10k = 30k, matching the total budget.
map.面积法是行业主流，体现代际公平；也可约定按户均摊，但需业主大会表决通过。: The area method is the industry mainstream, reflecting intergenerational fairness; per-household split can be agreed but needs owners'-meeting approval.
map.商业和住宅能一样吗？: Can commercial and residential be the same?
map.通常商业费率更高（电梯、空调负荷大），合同或规约须明确，不能混用。: Usually commercial rates are higher (elevator, AC load); the contract or rules must specify, not mix.
